actions.name: get_merchant
actions.description: Gets the connected Square business: name, country, currency and main location.

actions.name: list_locations
actions.description: Lists the business locations (stores) of the Square account.

actions.name: list_team_members
actions.description: Lists staff members of the Square account. Needs a connection created or reconnected with piece version 1.0.0 or later.

actions.name: create_customer
actions.description: Adds a customer profile to the Square Customer Directory.

actions.name: find_customers
actions.description: Searches customers by email, phone, reference ID or creation date.

actions.name: get_customer
actions.description: Gets a customer profile.

actions.name: update_customer
actions.description: Changes fields on a customer profile. Empty fields keep their current value.

actions.name: delete_customer
actions.description: Permanently deletes a customer profile.

actions.name: search_catalog_items
actions.description: Finds products and services in the Square catalog by name, category or location.

actions.name: get_catalog_item
actions.description: Gets a catalog item with its variations and prices.

actions.name: create_catalog_item
actions.description: Adds a product or service with one price to the Square catalog.

actions.name: update_item_variation_price
actions.description: Changes the price, SKU or name of an item variation.

actions.name: delete_catalog_object
actions.description: Permanently deletes a catalog item (with all its variations) or a single variation.

actions.name: get_inventory_count
actions.description: Gets the stock count of an item variation. Needs a connection created or reconnected with piece version 1.0.0 or later.

actions.name: adjust_inventory
actions.description: Adds or removes stock for an item variation. Needs a connection created or reconnected with piece version 1.0.0 or later.

actions.name: set_inventory_count
actions.description: Sets the in-stock count of an item variation after a stock take. Needs a connection created or reconnected with piece version 1.0.0 or later.

actions.name: create_order
actions.description: Creates an open order (no payment is taken).

actions.name: get_order
actions.description: Gets an order with its line items and totals.

actions.name: search_orders
actions.description: Finds orders by location, state, customer and creation date, newest first.

actions.name: update_order_state
actions.description: Marks an open order as completed or canceled.

actions.name: get_payment
actions.description: Gets a payment with its amount, status and card summary.

actions.name: list_payments
actions.description: Lists payments in a time range, newest first.

actions.name: record_external_payment
actions.description: Records money you received outside Square (cash, check, bank transfer, another app). Never charges a card. Needs a connection created or reconnected with piece version 1.0.0 or later.

actions.name: refund_payment
actions.description: Refunds all or part of a payment. Card refunds send real money back to the buyer and cannot be undone. Needs a connection created or reconnected with piece version 1.0.0 or later.

actions.name: get_refund
actions.description: Gets a refund and its status.

actions.name: list_refunds
actions.description: Lists refunds in a time range, newest first.

actions.name: create_payment_link
actions.description: Creates a Square checkout link for a fixed amount that you can send to a buyer. Needs a connection created or reconnected with piece version 1.0.0 or later.

actions.name: custom_api_call
actions.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint

triggers.name: new_order
triggers.description: Triggered when a new order is created

triggers.name: order_updated
triggers.description: Triggered when an order is updated

triggers.name: new_customer
triggers.description: Triggered when a customer is created

triggers.name: customer_updated
triggers.description: Triggered when a customer is updated

triggers.name: new_payment
triggers.description: Triggered when a new payment is created
